annotation_type.Description: Distinguishes sleep-stage labels from intervals that could not be staged.

Levels.sleep_stage: A sleep stage was assigned to this interval.
Levels.movement_artifact: Movement prevented a manual sleep-stage label.
Levels.unscored: The interval was intentionally left without a sleep-stage label.

sleep_stage.Description: Five-stage label used for comparison across scoring systems. R&K stages S3 and S4 are both represented as n3.

original_label.Description: Label before normalization. It preserves distinctions such as R&K S3 versus S4.

scoring_standard.Description: Rules used to produce the original label.

Levels.rk_1968: Rechtschaffen and Kales staging with separate S3 and S4 labels.
Levels.aasm_5stage: Five-stage Wake, N1, N2, N3 and REM label set used by the automated scorer.

annotation_method.Description: Whether the label came from manual consensus scoring or an automated method.

Levels.manual_consensus: Consensus label from human sleep scorers.

annotator_id.Description: Dataset-local identifier for the scorer, consensus procedure or software version.

channel.Description: Pipe-separated channel names matching the accompanying channels.tsv file.

confidence.Description: Confidence assigned to the reported stage, from 0 to 1. n/a means that the source did not provide confidence.
